part.text:
The robot followed the corridor to the end and is now resting in front of the red wall. It's about 0.8 m from the wall by the left sonar, and the camera shows the red wall straight ahead.

- **Route:** It turned left, right, left, right, then left again, ending about 6.1 m forward and 11.5 m left of where it started, by its own position tracking.
- **Obstacle stops:** Its collision protection stopped it several times when it got too close to the right-hand wall at the corners. Each time I stepped it sideways and it carried on. It never touched a wall or fell.
- **Final position:** It's still close to the right-hand wall (about 0.4 m on the right sonar). It also ended up turned about 9° left of straight-on to the wall. That shift probably happened when it crouched to rest.

It announced "I reached the red wall at the end of the corridor," then crouched and turned its motors off.
